content.text:
`node test.js` now passes and prints `OK`.

The bug was in `parseDuration` in `broken.js`: it ignored the seconds part of a duration. It only matched `h` and `m`, so inputs like `"1h55m26s"` lost the `26s`. That's why the 15 test cases that include seconds failed and all the others passed.

The fix is two lines: the pattern now matches `s` as well (`/(\d+)([hms])/g`), and a new branch adds seconds to the total. That also makes the function handle `"90s"` and `"1h2m3s"`, which its header comment already says it supports. I didn't touch `test.js`.
